'''Fenn's Landing''' was a warehouse on the planet [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] owned and operated by [[Slerog Fenn]]. He obtained it as a payment for a gambling debt and planned to use it to build a criminal empire. He rented it out for 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. It was the location of [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|OaS]] resupply base.
